VBO:0200785.summary: Quick to sound a forceful warning at unfamiliar people or animals, the Koyun dog is a regional flock guardian of Turkey’s eastern Black Sea uplands. It also guards its owner’s property and belongings. Found around Rize and Ordu, it has strong legs suited to the steep Canik hills, where sheep, goats and cattle are raised.
VBO:0200785.shortDescription: An eastern Black Sea flock guardian, known for strong warning barks and work around its owner’s animals and property.
